claim_assertions.claim_1: The constant-currency growth denominator excludes prior-period hedging.
claim_assertions.claim_2: The year-over-year change in consolidated hedging revenue reduced the reported Q2 FY2025 revenue increase by USD 214 million.
claim_assertions.claim_3: Google Cloud contributes more than half the reported Q2 year-over-year revenue increase.

definitions.geographic_currency: Two declared comparison contexts and four regions. CC current is current less that comparison FX effect.
definitions.consolidated_currency_bridge: For each comparison, sum regional current revenue less that comparison FX effect to reconstruct cc_current_usd_million. CC change is reconstructed CC current less prior unhedged regional revenue, and CC growth uses that prior unhedged denominator. Reconstruct prior/current reported bridge amounts as the matching regional sum plus consolidated hedging. Reported change decomposes into CC change, translation FX and the change in hedging. cc_disclosure_residual_usd_million is reconstructed regional CC current less the independent reported consolidated CC observation. Keep that observation independent.
definitions.revenue_growth_components: Use the seven mutually exclusive leaf components, including hedging. Each contribution divides by the current less prior sum of those same seven reported leaf components. Do not substitute a geography-based total if the independent representations disagree.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
